name: Starfist Squadron VR
summary:
Starfist Squadron VR 

Command Your Spaceships and Rule the Galaxy!

Take the controls of your very own spaceships in Starfist Squadron VR, an immersive space combat game that delivers the thrill of intergalactic battles right to your fingertips. Using your controllers as spaceships, you’ll experience the ultimate test of reflexes, strategy, and skill in a visually stunning cosmic adventure.

Two Exciting Game Modes
